//: Tiny Tapeout project configuration for tt_um_adpll_dco.
This is the TTSKY26d template's src/config.json with the design-specific
keys of this project added. It is the FIRST half of the hardening config:
tt-support-tools generates src/user_config.json (DESIGN_NAME, VERILOG_FILES,
DIE_AREA, FP_DEF_TEMPLATE, VDD_PIN, GND_PIN, RT_MAX_LAYER) from info.yaml and
merges the two into src/config_merged.json, which is what LibreLane reads.
user_config wins on any key it defines, so nothing here may restate the die.
The TT clock. 20 ns = 50 MHz, TT's documented floor; the demo board runs
slower, so constraining here is conservative in the only direction that
matters. info.yaml asks for 10 MHz because that is what the bring-up
firmware drives, not what the design is signed off against.
One SDC, shared with the project's own hardening run under openlane/, so
the ring is cut (set_disable_timing) and the osc clock is declared exactly
once in this repo. Every line in it carries its reason.
dco_matrix is a five-stage combinational ring of 167 named cells and the
census gate (T6) counts them on the built netlist. The resizer must not
upsize, clone or buffer anything inside it, and the divider's two first
stages are named cells too - their drive strength IS the T5 measurement.
The ring is a loop, so synthesis check reports it and LibreLane would
otherwise stop. It is deliberate and cut in the SDC.
src/tt_arch.vh includes vendor/dco_arch.vh by a path relative to src/, so
these directories are belt-and-braces: TT's own port check reads the
sources with no include path at all and must still resolve.
The ring's five nets carry 52 loads each; DELAY 4 with sizing is what T6
closed the clk domain with, and 35 % density is what fits 1x2 without
congesting the routing around the macro.
Diodes on ports would sit on the pins TT places for us; the router repairs
antennas instead, and T6 signed off 0 antenna violations that way.
Post-GRT timing repair, so the clk domain closes against real routing.
Sign off DRC on the streamed GDS, not on the DEF.
Hold slack margins - TT template defaults.
The linter runs; disabling it is not recommended by TT and not done here.
